title: Fractional physics-informed neural networks to model social media virality
abstract: arXiv:2611.07215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing models of social media virality either prescribe the functional form of engagement growth or assume a fixed mechanism by which past activity influences future engagement. We present a fractional physics-informed neural network that learns both the temporal memory and nonlinear growth dynamics of social media engagement, using symbolic regression to translate the learned dynamics into interpretable equations. Synthetic experiments at the deployment resolution of 24 hourly observations demonstrate that the fractional order and reaction law can be jointly recovered from clean data. Under observation noise, however, the standard pointwise physics residual drives the fractional order toward its lower bound through a scale artifact. We address this failure using a fully whitened residual that propagates observation noise through the fractional operator. tldr: 本文提出一种分数阶物理信息神经网络，能够同时学习社交媒体参与度的时间记忆与非线性增长动力学，并通过符号回归生成可解释方程，同时解决了观测噪声导致的分数阶估计偏差问题。
